summary: Lee County, VA USFS tower: 1938 cabin replaced by 30-ft steel tower in 1950; FFLOS-registered 2011 as US 922; register says tower removed; no staffing or site description found.

facts.design: 30-foot steel tower with 14'x14' wooden cab, replacing a 1938 cabin
facts.status_note: Register says the tower has been removed; no source describes what remains at the site

events.note: Earlier cabin built from scrap CCC building lumber and salvaged windows (per register)
Kingsport Times-News item dated March 19, 1950 reported preliminary work starting on a fire tower; the register gives 1950 as construction year
30-foot steel tower with 14'x14' wooden cab replaced the 1938 cabin
Registered April 10, 2011 as US 922, VA 8; nominated by Ron Stafford

evidence.supports: location in George Washington and Jefferson National Forests, Lee County, Virginia
evidence.quote: George Washington and Jefferson National Forests

evidence.supports: built by the U.S. Forest Service in 1950 as a 30-foot steel tower with 14'x14' cab, replacing a 1938 cabin
evidence.quote: Constructed in 1950 by the U.S. Forest Service, this 30' steel tower with 14'x14' wooden cab replaced an earlier cabin constructed in 1938 from scrap CCC building lumber and salvaged windows.

evidence.supports: news item published by the Kingsport Times-News
preliminary work starting on a fire tower at Jasper Cliff
evidence.quote: Preliminary work is being started on a fire tower at Jasper Cliff near here.

evidence.supports: new 30-foot steel structure to replace a shack used by the Forest Service
evidence.quote: The 30-foot steel structure will replace a shack that has been used for some time by the U.S. Forest Service.

notes_for_editor: The 1950 Kingsport Times-News item was read only as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the original newspaper was not checked. The register's 1938 cabin is described in its own text, so the 1938 event is sourced. Two web searches found no further history and no description of the site today. The brief's height 9.1 m matches the 30-foot tower. The earlier cabin's date is a register claim with no second source.
